name: eufy Smart Lock C34 (US)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth as transport interfaces and describes built-in Wi-Fi for the eufy app.

matter.note: CSA lists the eufy Smart Lock C34 from Anker Innovations (Matter 1.2, certified 2024-06-27, firmware V1.0.0.0, hardware V3), Matter over Thread.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. eufy says iOS 18 can add Matter devices without a hub, but remote control needs a HomePod, HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: eufy documents linking the eufy account to Google Assistant for the C34/E30. Matter also works with a Matter-capable Nest hub.

alexa.note: eufy documents linking the eufy account in the Alexa app for the C34/E30. Matter also works with a Matter-enabled Echo.

smartthings.note: eufy's Matter FAQ lists SmartThings and says a Matter hub is required; Thread needs a border router.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant docs page or eufy source names this lock. As Matter over Thread it may work through the Matter integration, unconfirmed.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi connects the lock to the eufy app without a bridge. Matter platforms need a Matter controller with a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No eufy source describes local-only control.

lockFit.note: Fits standard US and Canadian doors as a deadbolt replacement, with a keyhole for the mechanical key.

keypad.note: Passcode keypad on the lock. Unlike the E30, no fingerprint reader is listed.

power.note: Eight AA batteries; eufy rates up to 8 months at about 10 unlocks a day.

summary: The eufy Smart Lock C34 is a keypad deadbolt for standard US doors with built-in Wi-Fi and Matter over Thread. Matter brings it into Apple Home and SmartThings, while Alexa and Google Home connect by linking your eufy account. It runs on eight AA batteries, rated up to 8 months. Home Assistant is not confirmed.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router such as a HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K, or a Matter-capable Nest hub, Echo or SmartThings hub.
Apple Home remote control needs a home hub even though iOS 18 can add the lock without one.
